model.name: Addresses as scenario units, async-verified
model.description: Each address is an ior:class:Address scenario unit linked to its profile, stored as one string ordered large-to-small (Country City PostalCode Street HouseNumber); it is saved immediately and verified against OpenStreetMap asynchronously in the background, setting a verified badge and storing links to both OpenStreetMap and Google Maps on confirmation, never blocking on creation.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "address = one string large to small: Country City PostalCode Street HouseNumber. ior:class:Address linked to profile. Verify against OpenStreetMap on creation, store link to OpenStreetMap AND Google Maps." | TRON (answer #2): "Address verification is ASYNC - save immediately, verify in background against OpenStreetMap, show a verified badge when confirmed. NOT blocking on creation."

acceptanceCriteria.text: The address is stored as ONE string field `oneLine` ordered large to small: Country City PostalCode Street HouseNumber.
Canonical example: `DE Berlin 10115 Strasse 7` — country code first, postal code third, house number last.
The five tokens appear in exactly this sequence: Country, City, PostalCode, Street, HouseNumber (no reordering, no separate fields).
Each address is minted as an `ior:class:Address` scenario unit with its own v4 uuid in scenario/index.
The unit model carries exactly: { uuid, oneLine, verified, osmLink, gmapsLink, ownerIor }.
At creation the unit is { verified:false, osmLink:null, gmapsLink:null }.
ownerIor points to the owning Profile (nav parent, NOT a chain edge); the Profile carries the forward IOR in model.addresses[]. A profile may hold multiple Address units.
Save is immediate and NEVER blocks: the unit is index.put synchronously and returned before any network call.
A background VerifyJob(uuid) is enqueued off the request path (server worker), not awaited by the caller.
VerifyJob queries Nominatim GET /search?q=<oneLine>&format=json&limit=1 with a descriptive User-Agent, rate-limited to <=1 req/s, cached by oneLine.
On an OSM hit: unit.verified=true and links are set, then index.put — the verified badge appears on next render/push.
On an OSM miss: unit stays verified=false, persists, and displays WITHOUT a badge — never deleted, never errors the UI.
Badge states: UNVERIFIED (no badge) at creation and on miss; VERIFIED (badge shown) only after a confirmed OSM hit.
On verification, osmLink is stored as https://www.openstreetmap.org/?mlat=<lat>&mlon=<lon>#map=18/<lat>/<lon>.
On verification, gmapsLink is stored as https://www.google.com/maps?q=<lat>,<lon>.
BOTH links are stored on the same unit on success; both remain null while unverified.

testScenarios.name: format large-to-small
testScenarios.given: tokens Country=DE, City=Berlin, PostalCode=10115, Street=Strasse, HouseNumber=7
testScenarios.when: an Address unit is minted from them
testScenarios.then: unit.oneLine === 'DE Berlin 10115 Strasse 7' with tokens in Country City PostalCode Street HouseNumber order

testScenarios.name: unit shape at creation
testScenarios.then: an ior:class:Address unit exists with {uuid, oneLine, verified:false, osmLink:null, gmapsLink:null, ownerIor:P} AND profile.model.addresses[] contains the Address IOR

testScenarios.name: immediate non-blocking save
testScenarios.given: Nominatim stubbed with an artificial delay
testScenarios.then: it returns synchronously with verified:false BEFORE the network resolves (no await on Nominatim in the request path); the VerifyJob is enqueued

testScenarios.name: async verify HIT
testScenarios.given: Nominatim stubbed to return one result with lat/lon

testScenarios.name: async verify MISS
testScenarios.then: unit stays verified:false, persists in the index, renders WITHOUT a badge, and the UI shows no error

testScenarios.name: badge state transition in UI
testScenarios.given: an unverified Address unit rendered in the detail view
testScenarios.when: verification succeeds and the view re-renders
testScenarios.then: no badge before; verified badge present after

testScenarios.name: rate-limit + cache
testScenarios.given: two Address units with identical oneLine
testScenarios.then: the second resolves from cache with no second Nominatim request; request rate stays <=1/s

testScenarios.name: multiple addresses per profile
testScenarios.given: a profile given two different addresses
testScenarios.then: two distinct ior:class:Address units exist, both in profile.addresses[], each independently verifiable
